incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: dedicated-eu-west-2 pool p99 latency spike > SLO (3.2s). Alerting on-call and paging #incidents. Link: https://internal.ops/redwood/alerts/1755012345

jess: saw this — p95 ~850ms but p99 jumped to 3.2s ~3m ago, streaming stalls visible. Looks like queue depth climbed and warmup completions lagging.

sam: confirming metrics —
```
metric: dedicated-eu-west-2
p50: 120ms
p95: 860ms
p99: 3.2s
queue_depth: 420 -> 1200
warmup_inflight: 38 -> 2 (stuck)
avg_warmup_time: 48s (baseline 9s)
```

mike.s: streaming client reports stall frames, clients see partial tokens then pause. Suspect autoscaler handshake failing to attach hotshot instances.

anjali: adding context — there was a burst from a new onboarding customer at ~1755012200, many concurrent short chats with long context lengths. That increased KV cache pressure.

oncall-uk: I'm on it. Are we currently using fallback routing to shared-hosted? If not, can we toggle to reduce pressure?

jess: fallback still off for this tier. Options: 1) manual scale-up of dedicated pool (fast but warmup cost), 2) enable regional reroute to hosted API for lower-priority orgs, 3) apply temporary throttle to long-seq requests. Thoughts?

sam: recommend immediate combined approach: manual + reroute. Manual scale to add 4 hotshots with warmup preseed, and flip routing for non-enterprise customers. I'll run commands.

mike.s: +1. Also prepare model-variant fallback (quantized) for streaming to reduce per-token load — quality might degrade slightly but keeps clients alive.

sam: running manual scale (rictl):
```
rictl pool scale --pool dedicated-eu-west-2 --add 4 --warmup-preseed=true --reason "emergency-burst-1755012345"
```

sam: issued. API shows handshake stream started but warmup times still showing high for 2 instances. Heartbeat logs showing slow image pull on eu-west-2 nodes.

anjali: initiating non-critical reroute: set routing policy priority -> hosted for customers with tag=non-critical.

anjali: command:
```
routingctl update --region eu-west-2 --match tag:non-critical --dest hosted --priority 90
```

oncall-uk: I've paged infra and networking (cc @mike.s) to check image registry throttling for eu-west-2. If pulls are slow we can swap to pre-warmed AMI snapshots.

mike.s: infra confirmed registry rate-limited by provider for our burst. Launching instances from baked AMI now.

incident-bot: NOTE: on-call handover scheduled in 30m. Current assignee oncall-uk.

sam: warmup progress update: +4 instances requested, 3 are initializing, 1 failed due to pull timeout and will be relaunched from AMI. Queue depth falling from 1200 -> 640 now that reroute is active. p99 down to 1.8s.

jess: starting live mitigation checklist:
- reduce priority for long-context requests (throttle 3rps)
- enable quantized fallback for streaming for non-critical orgs
- continue scale + ensure KV cache prefetch for new nodes

mike.s: applied throttle rule via ratelimit service: tag=long-context limit=3rps for non-critical.

anjali: enabled model fallback for streaming (variant=v1-quant-8) for non-critical customers.

sam: p99 now 1.1s, p95 540ms, queue_depth 230. Streaming stalls reduced in client logs.

oncall-uk: infra finished AMI-based nodes, warmup completed across 4 hotshots. Continuing to monitor. Preparing handoff notes for next on-call.

jess: customer-impact assessment: affected customers: 8 non-critical orgs saw degraded streaming (partial tokens, stalls) for ~18m. No enterprise customers hit SLOs due to routing. We should notify support with a short RCA note and workaround.

mike.s: filing interim incident report in ops board. I'll include metrics, commands used, and timeline.

incident-bot: INCIDENT status: mitigated -> monitoring (p99 returned below SLO). Auto-escalation disabled. Incident channel will remain open until postmortem.

jess: moving to postmortem phase. Key actions: investigate registry rate limits, improve warmup prefetch heuristics, add automatic fallback routing when warmup handshake latency > threshold.

oncall-uk: handing off to oncall-eu in 25m. Leaving runbook notes and current ops state.

sam: logs for handoff (snippet):
```
[1755012379] handshake start pool=dedicated-eu-west-2 instance=i-0a1234
[1755012384] warmup done instance=i-0a1234 warmup=10s
[1755012390] handshake failed instance=i-0b5678 err=registry_timeout
[1755012412] instance replaced instance=i-0b5678->i-0c9012
[1755012460] reroute applied tag=non-critical -> hosted
```

anjali: thanks all. I'll coordinate customer comms with support. Closing live mitigation actions.

incident-bot: Thread archived for follow-up: write postmortem and tag: infra, eng-sre, product.
